changelog: Orion 3.6 — one fix: the microphone. Wake listening is now silent, like Hey Google. Before, the speech recognizer played a listening beep every time it restarted — and in a quiet room it restarts every few seconds, so you heard beeps every few seconds. Now the sounds the recognizer makes are muted around each listen and restored the exact moment Orion needs to speak, quiet-room restarts count as the normal rhythm instead of errors, and a recognizer that keeps failing backs off instead of looping tight. Orion's own voice is never muted. New Terms section 6W states the silent-listening rules — the app will ask you to agree again, once. One honest note: the silence itself can only be proven on your phone — if your Pixel's recognizer plays any sound outside the system, music and notification streams, you would still hear it; say the word and it gets chased down.
